eldritch-blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch-blast.note: Separate attack roll per beam; beams scale with character level, not slot.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.note: Temp HP equal to the spellcasting modifier at the start of each turn.

magic-missile.name: Magic Missile
magic-missile.note: Auto-hit. Three darts, each 1d4+1 Force; +1 dart per slot above 1st.

scorching-ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching-ray.note: Three rays, each its own attack roll; +1 ray per slot above 2nd.

spirit-guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit-guardians.note: Recurring aura damage; the sim applies it once per enemy turn in the aura.
